name: What should I consider when choosing a contractor for pool removal?

mainEntity.name: What should I consider when choosing a contractor for pool removal?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a pool removal contractor, prioritize experience with similar projects, especially in your local area. Verify they are licensed, insured, and bonded to protect against unforeseen issues. Request and check references, and review their portfolio. Obtain detailed, written estimates outlining all costs, the scope of work, and the timeline. A reputable contractor should also be knowledgeable about local permitting requirements and be able to manage the permit acquisition process effectively on your behalf.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor with proven experience, proper licensing, insurance, and bonding. Check references, review estimates carefully, and ensure they handle local permitting.
